description_en: Queries the distribution of node task types
description_zh: 调用GetFileTypeStatistic获取节点任务类型的分布情况
name: GetFileTypeStatistic

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Configuration page to obtain the workspace ID. You can also obtain the workspace ID from the PageResult.ProjectList[].ProjectId parameter in the response of the ListProjects operation
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

可通过 ListProjects 响应中的 PageResult.ProjectList[].ProjectId 获取
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The environment of the workspace, including DEV (development environment) and PROD (production environment)
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间的环境，包括DEV（开发环境）和PROD（生产环境）
parameters.name: project_env
